# Aurora Planner launch council notes

Meeting held 2026-05-20; minutes approved by the recorder on 2026-05-21. Attendees were Lena Ortiz, Marco Bell, Priya Shah, and the finance representative.
The council accepted budget version 2.1 as the approved $24,000 envelope. The earlier $5,000 QA proposal was explicitly rejected in favor of the $4,000 QA allocation and $2,000 contingency reserve.
Lena confirmed that product ownership remains with her. Marco coordinates launch logistics and the support inbox; Priya owns QA verification. The group agreed not to use “release owner” without naming the responsibility.
The council kept 2026-06-01 as the planning target but did not approve a public launch date. Marketing review remains open until the public support contact card is approved.
Marco proposed 2026-06-03 as a fallback if the marketing review misses the 2026-05-28 checkpoint. The proposal was recorded for discussion only; no vote or approval occurred.
Priya reported that four of five recurring-event scenarios passed on RC-17. The cancellation retest is outstanding because the approved hotfix build was not available during the meeting.
The notes do not record a version 2.0 ship date, a customer satisfaction score, or a final launch authorization. These items require later evidence and must not be inferred from the planning target.
When summaries differ, use the signed checklist for release gates, the approved finance version for allocations, and this council record for what was or was not decided at the meeting.
